newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar softens as cenbank stays away.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar softens as cenbank stays away.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar softened to 470.75/472.00 bolivars per dollar as the Central Bank stood aside and provided no dollars, traders said.
On Tuesday, the bolivar closed at 470.50/471.75 per dollar.
"Banks were waiting for the Central Bank to come in with dollars -- which it never did -- so at the end of the day the (dollar) rate closed up and many players were left short," said one trader.
Brokers reported moderate demand for dollars. The exchange rate softened "because the Central Bank didn't sell dollars," said one.
